module: Minimal utility to know whether a vehicle is resting on its wheels. It casts a static ray downward from the bottom of the vehicle's bounding box (raised by 0.3 m) and compares the distance to the ground against a 1.1 m threshold.
notes: The ray is 1.5 m long; the method does not look at the vehicle's orientation, only at whether there is ground under the center of the box: an overturned vehicle close to the ground can therefore be judged "on its wheels".
If the ray hits nothing, castRayStatic returns a distance greater than or equal to the ray length, so the function returns false.

isOnWheels.desc: Tests proximity of the ground under the vehicle's center using a static ray cast downward.

returns.desc: true if the ground is 1.1 m away or less; false if the vehicle is missing from map.objects.
